title: Spider-Man 2
tagline: The film’s Doc Ock story, in a city you can cross on a web line.
summary: The home-console game adapts Spider-Man 2 and is remembered for letting the player swing across an open Manhattan. Handheld versions are simpler adaptations by other teams. Treyarch made the main console game.
gameplay: Open-borough web swinging on the home consoles, with physics-based swing speed and missions that retell Otto Octavius’s story.
